text:
alex: FYI GPU pool us-west-2/gpu-research is saturated (100%). Autoscaler keeps launching then nodes go NotReady. Big research sweep 'eltu-sweep' launched ~600 pods.

maria: pod list?

alex: ```
NAMESPACE   NAME                          STATUS    NODE                RESTARTS
research    eltu-train-xyz-0              Pending                 
research    eltu-train-xyz-1              Pending                 
... (~600 Pending)
```

sam: looks like they requested gpu:4 and nodeSelector gpu=v100. fragmentation + preemptible churn -> autoscaler oscillation.

tanya: plan: (1) cordon research nodepool, (2) create ResourceQuota in research ns to limit GPUs, (3) taint research-pool to NoSchedule, (4) provision small on-demand emergency pool. doing steps now.

alex: running: `kubectl cordon nodepool-research-node-0` then `kubectl drain nodepool-research-node-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30` 

infra-bot: autoscaler event: scaleUpGroup: gpu-research-group -> desired: 8 current: 2 (2026-06-12T14:22:10Z)

ryan: I'm applying ResourceQuota:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: research-gpu-quota
spec:
  hard:
    limits.ai.gpu: "50"
```

maria: also patch priorityClass for sweep to `batch-low` so they can be preempted without hitting prod.

sam: temp taint to prevent new scheduling: `kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=research exclusive=yes:NoSchedule` 

alex: spun up emergency pool 'dedicated-gpu-emergency-1' (3 on-demand p4s). set cluster-autoscaler min=3 for that pool. cost note: ~$7k/day added, lowering as we scale down.

tanya: for long term: add admission webhook to enforce max GPU per pod and suggest bin-packing scheduler and gang-scheduling for sweeps.

infra-bot: metrics: GPU util spike -> https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/xyz (panel: gpu-utilization, timeframe: 1h)

alex: followups: I've killed 120 runaway jobs with `kubectl delete job -n research --selector sweep=eltu --field-selector status.successful=0` and notified research team @sam, @ryan. Recommending quota and scheduler changes before we untaint.

sam: will create PR with quota + LimitRange + docs for sweeps. thanks all :thumbsup:
